idea-plugin.name: MCP Config Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Reads .mcp.json / .vscode/mcp.json / claude_desktop_config.json while you edit it and marks the lines that hand an AI agent more than you meant - unpinned servers, literal credentials, plaintext transport, whole-home filesystem roots. 23 rules, offline, no server is ever started.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → MCP Config Guard: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 23 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/mcp-config-guard (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/mcp-config-guard

action.text: MCP Config Guard: Check This File
action.description: Run MCP Config Guard on the file in the editor
